test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Was the speech delivered by the prime minister at the international summit?

options.text: Did the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?
Has the prime minister delivered the speech at the international summit?
Is the prime minister delivering the speech at the international summit?
Will the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, and the task is to convert it into the **active voice**.
 
• In the passive voice sentence, "Was the speech delivered by the prime minister at the international summit?" the subject is "the speech" and the doer of the action is "the prime minister."
 
• To convert this into the active voice:
 
 
• Start with the doer of the action, i.e., "the prime minister."
 
• Use the correct verb form. In this case, "Was delivered" (passive) changes to "Did deliver" (active, past tense).
 
• Maintain the additional details of the sentence, i.e., "the speech at the international summit."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Did the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Did the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?" – **Correct**. This is the active voice version of the given passive voice sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "Has the prime minister delivered the speech at the international summit?" – Incorrect. This changes the tense to present perfect.
 
• **Option 3:** "Is the prime minister delivering the speech at the international summit?" – Incorrect. This changes the tense to present continuous.
 
• **Option 4:** "Will the prime minister deliver the speech at the international summit?" – Incorrect. This changes the tense to future simple.
